title: Design a launch screen that’s nearly identical to the first screen of your app or game

statement.en: Apply the documented Launching guidance to design a launch screen that’s nearly identical to the first screen of your app or game.
statement.ja: 「Launching」において「Design a launch screen that’s nearly identical to the first screen of your app or game」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Launching experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるLaunchingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
